sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce and the Hello Elementor theme (with the Elementor mini cart / menu cart widget) are active.
  4. Open any single product page and click “Add to cart”. The product is added with AJAX and the mini cart refreshes.
sections.faq:
Can I turn AJAX add to cart off for one product?

Yes. Add a custom field disable_ajax_add_to_cart with the value 1 to the product. The optional pro add-on gives you a checkbox for this in the product editor.

Is there a hook for developers?

Yes. mcafw_after_add_to_cart runs after an add to cart request (arguments: product ID, variation ID, quantity). mcafw_ds_added_to_cart runs only when the item was really added (it also receives the cart item key). On the front-end the mcafw_added_to_cart jQuery event is triggered on document.body with the server response.

What is the “pro” folder?

If a pro folder exists inside the plugin, the premium features load automatically (plug and play). If the folder does not exist, the free version works exactly the same, without any errors.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4

  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.
  • Security: the add to cart request now parses and sanitizes the submitted form field by field, validates every value type, and checks that WooCommerce is available before use.
  • Security: script version no longer uses the current time, so browsers can cache the script.
  • Fix: PHP 8 compatibility for Product Configurator data (array_key_exists() on objects) and several undefined index/offset notices.
  • Fix: a failed AJAX request no longer leaves the page blocked and the button locked.
  • Fix: variable products with “any” attribute options are added with the selected attributes.
  • Fix: no fatal error on non-WooCommerce pages when WooCommerce is deactivated.
  • Enhancement: WooCommerce HPOS compatibility declared.
  • Enhancement: the AJAX response now includes added and notices; new mcafw_ds_added_to_cart action, mcafw_ds_response, mcafw_ds_localize_data and mcafw_ds_cart_item_data filters, and a mcafw_added_to_cart front-end event.
  • Enhancement: optional plug and play “pro” folder (settings page, toast notices, redirect after add to cart, per-product switch, statistics, add-on field support).
  • All existing features are unchanged.

1.1.2

  • Enhancement: Added mcafw_after_add_to_cart action hook for developers to attach custom functionality after an item is added to the cart. 25/10/2025
  • Improvement: Refactored AJAX handler for cleaner structure, better sanitization, and improved error handling.
  • Improvement: Optimized cart fragment refresh logic for faster updates on Elementor mini-cart widgets.
  • Tweak: Cleaned up script enqueue conditions and added nonce validation for improved security.
  • Dev: General code cleanup and stability improvements.

1.1.0
